label: CONFIRMED: Claude Stop defers on non-empty background_tasks, stamps deferredAt and prints nothing; a never-draining task parks the hop with no notice (stop-arm.mjs:119-135, relaunch-core.cjs:1151).
CONFIRMED with correction: the Claude sub-agent guard denies seven relaunch commands (README.md:211), not only prepare and claim as the report says.

CONFIRMED: the OpenCode plugin arms on session.idle with no child busy check (session-relaunch.js:418-437); child ids are a plain skip set (:158-164). Whether a child can still run at parent idle remains UNCONFIRMED (runtime behaviour).
CITATION PARTLY WRONG: the 3 s idle wait is killer.cjs:28 DEFAULT_IDLE_MS=3000, not README.md:130.
Fix mechanism exists: opencode-goal.js tracks session.status busy/retry per session (:3623-3626, :3038); the relaunch plugin could store it for child ids and skip the arm while any child is busy.

CONFIRMED: prepare refuses only for a direct shell child of the runtime (session-relaunch.cjs:277-281, :524); the & worker pattern of cli-codex SKILL.md:213 and cli-devin SKILL.md:258 is invisible to it; killer signals one pid (killer.cjs:796). Orphan survival stays inferred.
CONFIRMED: the nudge requires only Active command: (nudge.cjs:183-185); handoff.md:132 names running processes in prose only; receiver re-runs the command (README.md:160).

RESOLVED: markOrphanedLineages (fanout-pool.cjs:307-324) has no pid liveness check; detectOrphanedLineages (:284-305) counts any started label without completed/failed/orphan_requeued, so a live lineage is requeued on re-run.

CONFIRMED: fan-out lineages are detached (fanout-run.cjs:2113), group-killed only on runner SIGINT/SIGTERM (:348-353, :589-593, :715-730); the nudge releases the lock before prepare (nudge.cjs:199-203); a re-run requeues (:3520, :386) and reuses the stored session id (:631-646), giving two writers per lineage.

Second fan-out fix: runner keeps per-lineage liveness pids (fanout-run.cjs:3525, fanout-pool.cjs:176-196); a pid on the started event would let detectOrphanedLineages skip live lineages. Whether started events carry a pid is UNCONFIRMED.
